Thanks again for taking the time today, Sam — really helpful to understand BrightLeaf's ingestion and latency pain points. Recap of what we heard:
- High throughput batch embedding job for nightly pipelines (~5M docs/month)
- Interactive search experience with 200–300ms 95th P99 target for UI calls
- Compliance requirement: regionally isolated logs and retention controls

Next step I propose: a 30-minute product intro/demo where we walk through the hosting options (hosted vs dedicated), show latency/cost tradeoffs for a similar workload, and outline a mutual action plan. Suggested 30-min slots (all US/Pacific):
1) Tue Jun 23 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
2) Tue Jun 23 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT
3) Wed Jun 24 — 11:00–11:30 AM PT

If none of these work, tell me two windows that do and I’ll coordinate. Would be great if you can join with Jordan (search/product) and anyone from infra who'd own deployment. I’ve attached a short agenda.

Thanks,
